events.title: Update 0.6.7: Expanded language support and in-game language switching
events.summary: Demo 0.6.7 is now available for Chinese Board & Card Games Museum. This update improves English and Traditional Chinese localization. The interface supports Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English. Choose a language in the game's Steam properties; the game reads that setting at startup. Switch languages in the game without restarting your current match. The museum hall, tables, and settings update together. Traditional Chinese uses Chinese audio. events.title: Demo 0.6.6: New Card Backs, Clearer Results, and Better Keyboard Controls
events.summary: Hello, everyone! This update focuses on the experience from entering the museum and starting a game to reviewing the results. It introduces new coin-pattern card and tile backs, clearer explanations of results and scoring, and improvements to keyboard controls. New coin-pattern backs Playing cards and mahjong tiles now feature a coin-pattern design, replacing the previous Chinese character markings. events.title: Demo 0.6.5: AI Improvements, Bug Fixes, and Smoother Camera Transitions
events.summary: Hello everyone! Demo 0.6.5 focuses on AI behavior, table information, and the experience of entering and leaving game tables in the museum. AI and Difficulty In Dou Dizhu on Normal difficulty, the AI now correctly distinguishes teammates from opponents and considers remaining hand sizes, played cards, and card combinations, reducing unnecessary plays over a teammate. events.title: Demo 0.6.4: Feedback, Replay and Gameplay Improvements
events.summary: Dear players, Demo 0.6.4 of Chinese Board & Card Games Museum is ready. This update improves feedback and replays, optimizes selected gameplay interactions, and fixes window resizing and Dou Di Zhu bidding issues. Thank you for sharing your experiences and suggestions during the Demo. events.title: Welcome to the Museum: Demo 0.6.2 Steam Next Fest Update
events.summary: Welcome to Chinese Board Game Museum. For Steam Next Fest, we have rearranged the exhibition and invite you back to the streets and courtyards of China in the 1980s and 1990s. Each of our six games has a home: Dou Dizhu in a Wuhan alley on a summer night, Guan Dan beside the canals of Huai’an, Pao De Kuai on a Changsha rooftop in autumn, Ka Wu Xing in a Xiaogan hall in winter, and Sichuan Mahjong in a Chengdu teahouse in early spring. events.title: Chinese Board Game Museum: Steam Next Fest Gameplay Tour
events.summary: Steam Next Fest is here! We are YANDRA STUDIO, and this is our gameplay introduction to Chinese Board Game Museum. The film follows the full journey from the map to exhibit details, the game setup screen and finally the table. It introduces Dou Dizhu, Guan Dan, Pao De Kuai, Sheng Ji, Sichuan Mahjong and Ka Wu Xing, alongside five city settings and the museum. events.title: Demo 0.5.0 Update | Online Dou Dizhu & Gameplay Improvements
events.summary: Chinese Board Game Museum Demo 0.5.0 is now available! Online Dou Dizhu on Steam Join a game through public lobbies, friend rooms, or room codes. You can also invite friends through Steam. This update improves the ready-up, game start, results, and rematch flow, along with initial synchronization and connection recovery messages.
